# Vendor files (not committed)

SainSmart's package for the 101-70-208: schematic, instruction PDF with the
stock command table, Windows tool and CH341 driver.

```sh
curl -LO https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/s3.image.smart/download/101-70-208/101-70-208.zip
python3 -m zipfile -e 101-70-208.zip .
```

Product page: https://www.sainsmart.com/products/16-channel-9-36v-usb-relay-module
